1.1: This psalm is ascribed to David as his own composition (though it is outside the number ), after he had fought in single combat with Goliath. 151 I was small among my brothers and the youngest in my father’s house; I tended my father’s sheep.
1.2: My hands made a harp; my fingers fashioned a lyre.
1.3: And who will tell my Lord? The Lord himself; it is he who hears.
1.4: It was he who sent his messenger and took me from my father’s sheep and anointed me with his anointing oil.
1.5: My brothers were handsome and tall, but the Lord was not pleased with them.
1.6: I went out to meet the foreigner, and he cursed me by his idols.
1.7: But I drew his own sword; I beheaded him and removed disgrace from the people of Israel.
